items.html: Now, after the aforementioned restriction and Parsa, the lights there are found (19) to be very many at the place of the Chazeh [chest]. And their ascent there was of benefit for the need of (20) Mayin Nukvin [female waters]. And this you will understand from what was written concerning AVI, that they were each divided in two: Aba and Israel Saba, and Bina and Tevuna. And the discerning will understand that so it was here. For the name AB of AK, which are the Mochin within the Galgalta, on the inside, and the name SAG, which is from the Ozen downward to the Tabur in his internality — and not in the discernment of the lights that come out outward, but the inner lights of AK themselves — behold, the AB, which is male, being his Mochin, coupled with the Taamim of SAG, which are of the inner AHP and are the roots of the lights and the branches that come out outward; and these Taamim of the inner SAG are for the female, and they coupled together.
